title: Technical English — Course 5, Semester 2 — Pilot Variant 13

tasks.prompt: Listening 1. When will the integration handover take place?
tasks.audioText: The systems integration coordinator will hold a handover review on Wednesday at one thirty. Mechanical, electrical and software teams should bring their interface lists and latest status reports. The meeting will identify unresolved interfaces, document dependencies and actions that need joint approval. The coordinator will record each action with an owner and a due date.

tasks.prompt: Listening 2. Which documents should the teams bring?
tasks.audioText: The systems integration coordinator will hold a handover review on Wednesday at one thirty. Mechanical, electrical and software teams should bring their interface lists and latest status reports. The meeting will identify unresolved interfaces, document dependencies and actions that need joint approval. The coordinator will record each action with an owner and a due date.
options: Interface lists and latest status reports

tasks.prompt: During an equipment integration project, the mechanical team confirmed the mounting arrangement, but the electrical team was waiting for the connector specification. The software team had completed a draft interface description but needed the final sensor reference. The coordinator recorded these dependencies and arranged a joint review so that the teams could confirm compatible information before the design baseline was updated. Reading 1. What information was the electrical team waiting for?
Why was a joint review arranged?
options: To assign all integration work to the software team
To confirm compatible information before updating the design baseline
To approve the draft interface without checking its references
To release the design baseline before the teams exchange information

tasks.prompt: The design baseline ___ after the interface information is confirmed.
Choose TWO items that help manage system integration.
A defined connection or point of interaction between system parts is an ___.
One team's design depends on another team's unconfirmed specification. What should you say?
options: Proceed and assume the specification will not change.
This interface remains open until the specification is confirmed; could we assign an owner and review date?
Close the action to save time.
The dependency does not need to be recorded.

tasks.prompt: Put the stages of system integration handover in a logical order.
options: Assign owners and joint review actions
Update the design baseline after confirmation
correctOrder: Assign owners and joint review actions
Update the design baseline after confirmation

tasks.prompt: Write 100–120 words summarising how mechanical, electrical and software teams should manage an unresolved interface during system integration.
tasks.rubric: 8 points total. Score each criterion 0–2: (1) Interface issue — 2: identifies the unresolved interface and the relevant mechanical/electrical/software boundaries; 1: partial; 0: absent. (2) Coordination — 2: explains joint review, information exchange and agreed ownership; 1: partial; 0: absent. (3) Control of uncertainty — 2: explains documenting assumptions/open points and not treating the interface as resolved before evidence/approval; 1: partial; 0: absent or incorrect. (4) English — 2: clear cross-disciplinary technical language; 1: errors but meaning clear; 0: meaning frequently unclear.
